UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow dark modern SaaS aesthetic inspired by launchuicomponents.com and modern engineering studios.
All files to create or modify are .js and .jsx files (not .tsx).
Never use fully transparent backgrounds behind text or dropdown menus. Always use backdrop-blur with minimum 70% opacity dark tint (e.g., bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-xl).
Every interactive button, tab, modal trigger, card, and input MUST contain a unique, semantic 'data-testid' attribute.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance stagger, hover card elevation, and glowing border beams.
Preserve all real brand context from techyugantar.in: Based in Varanasi, India, 50+ projects shipped, 18+ industries, full-stack Next.js, Django, Python, Flutter, AI integrations.
Include real case studies mentioned: LOEXA Africa, Jyotify, Maa Sulakhi, ItWebDream, Talk AcharyaJi.
Ensure 100% responsive design from mobile (360px) to ultra-wide displays without horizontal overflow.
Use sonner for instant toast feedback on form submissions and quote calculations.
